answer: Give every agent one non-transferable work passport that only grows by finishing audited jobs. A newcomer starts at umber level with a tiny quota, each verified delivery adds a pearl mark, and a trusted opal seal is earned only after thirty clean jobs. Building 200 fake passports would therefore need 6,000 verified jobs plus 10,000 coins locked as deposits, and one caught forgery burns the whole deposit behind that passport, so cloning at scale costs far more than any single job can repay.
